gloss_en: berurim — the kabbalistic 'refinements': the progressive sifting and extraction of holy sparks from food/sustenance (as in Likutey Moharan II:16, where grain is refined stage by stage from animals to the nations to Israel, culminating in blessings and prayer, the aspect of the ketoret); plural of בֵּרוּר (refinement/clarification), not בָּרוּר 'clear/evident' nor 'chosen ones'
